post.title: LLD for Ride Booking App: Designing Uber/Lyft
post.subtitle: How do you match a rider with a driver in real-time? We break down the Low-Level Design of a ride-sharing app using the Observer and Strategy patterns
post.brief: A ride-booking system (Uber/Lyft-style) needs three interleaved sub-systems: real-time driver location tracking (Observer Pattern), nearest-driver matching (geospatial query), and dynamic pricing (Strategy Pattern). Getting state transitions right — Requested → Accepted → InProgress → Completed — is the core LLD challenge.
